annotations.title: Check dates and price a stay

description: Check one villa for specific dates and price the stay. Availability is 'available' (the villa's live calendar shows every night free), 'booked' (with the booked nights) or 'unknown' (no current calendar; the team checks with the owner, so it is not booked). The estimate adds up the published nightly rates night by night, picks the bedroom option that sleeps the party, and includes 13% local taxes; it also reports the minimum stay. It is an estimate: the team confirms the exact price with the villa before anything is paid. Returns a link to the site's booking form with the stay filled in.

departure.description: Departure date as YYYY-MM-DD, the morning the guests leave.

guests.description: Number of guests, children included. Chooses the bedroom option to price; leave out for the smallest.

villa.description: The villa's slug, name or numeric id.
